description: How guests, everyday hosts, and professional operators relate to each other: who books whom, who runs the stay, how money moves through the platform, and which feedback loops sustain marketplace trust.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Booking stays and contracting listing management

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Running check-in, the stay itself, and day-to-day hosting operations

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Payments, payouts, and owner remittances through the platform

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Reviews, issue signals, and performance feedback

relations.name: Books stays with everyday hosts
relations.description: Discovers, shortlists, and books individually hosted homes and rooms, converting search intent into confirmed reservations with clear pricing and cancellation terms.

relations.name: Books professionally managed stays
relations.description: Books listings run by professional operators and co-host businesses, often for larger groups, longer remote-work stays, or event travel where consistent standards matter.

relations.name: Hosts and services the stay
relations.description: Handles pre-arrival messaging, check-in instructions, house rules, and on-stay support so the booked stay runs without surprises.

relations.name: Delivers standardized stay operations
relations.description: Runs portfolio-level operations for guests: staffed messaging, cleaning turnover, maintenance response, and consistent check-in across many listings and markets.

relations.name: Pays the booking through the platform
relations.description: Pays the booking total at reservation; the platform holds the funds and releases the host payout after check-in, netting out service fees and any adjustments.

relations.name: Delegates listing management to co-hosts
relations.description: Contracts a professional co-host operator to launch and run their listing under agreed permissions and a management-fee arrangement when self-hosting becomes too much.

relations.name: Remits owner payouts
relations.description: Passes through the owner's share of booking revenue after the agreed management fee, with statements that reconcile occupancy, payouts, and expenses per listing.

relations.name: Reviews and rates the stay
relations.description: Leaves post-stay reviews and ratings that build or erode the host's reputation and drive future booking conversion.

relations.name: Feeds review and issue signals
relations.description: Sends reviews, complaints, and claim signals that professional operators aggregate into portfolio quality dashboards and use to fix underperforming listings.
